title: Fix overtrading in DynamicBreakout and SmaCrossover
body:
Resolves Issue #88: Fix overtrading in DynamicBreakout and SmaCrossover via Cooldown debouncing and Reversal fix.

The backtests showed massive overtrading in these strategies. This commit implements a temporal debounce logic using a configurable `cooldown_bars` threshold. Additionally, it addresses a state-management issue inside `_on_buy_signal` and `_on_sell_signal` where `self.current_signal` was being set to `None` upon closing an opposite position, causing the strategy to become immediately vulnerable to signaling again in the very next tick/bar and creating a loop. Now it explicitly sets the `current_signal` variable to the intended new state ("BUY" or "SELL").

As part of the fix, test suite execution was also refactored to run `run_single_backtest_worker` inside a `ProcessPoolExecutor` to isolate the Rust engine runs and prevent `Fatal Python error: Aborted` core panics.
